admin.title: Route lines again
admin.hint: Routes the legs and coach rides of all accounts through the configured routing service. A line someone drew or recorded is never replaced, and when a request fails the stored line stays. When the service's daily quota is used up, the run stops and carries on by itself the next day.
admin.modeAllHint: "All" also routes lines that were routed before and uses more of the quota.
admin.notConfigured: No routing service is set up – there is nothing to route without one.
admin.failed: The run could not be started.
admin.loadFailed: The state of the last run could not be loaded.

roadtrip.notConfigured: No routing service is set up – the legs stay as they are.
